settings.environment.explanation:
A viewing environment combines multiple discovery pages, libraries, and modules. Create multiple environments for different preferences or situations, choose which opens by default, and optionally lock them.

Switching the active environment changes the discovery page and available content. Switching tabs on this page only views and edits different environments’ settings.
settings.environment.defaultEntryHelp: When set as default, Rex opens this environment on every restart. Only one environment can be the default. If none is set, Rex opens the last used environment.
